summary: Modal dialog that interrupts the flow to ask for confirmation of an important or irreversible action.
whenNotToUse: Informational messages: use Alert or Toast.
Easily undoable actions: prefer a Toast with “Undo”.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: If it returns a Promise, shows the pending state; stays open if the Promise rejects.

props.name: tone
props.description: Destructive style for the title and confirm button.

inherits: Dialog props except footer, size and hideCloseButton.

keyboard.action: Toggles between Cancel and Confirm (focus trap).

accessibility: role="alertdialog"; initial focus goes to Cancel to prevent accidental confirmation.
Clicking the backdrop does not close the dialog.
The pending state is announced on the confirm button.
responsive: Narrow width; buttons wrap on small screens.
commonMistakes: Using it for every action: it trains users to confirm without reading.

examples.name: Controlled
examples.title: Controlled with custom labels
examples.description: isOpen + onOpenChange: the dialog opens only when there are unsaved changes; onCancel and onConfirm update the outcome.

examples.name: TypeToConfirm
examples.title: Confirm disabled until you type the name
examples.description: isConfirmDisabled stays on until the text matches the repository name.

examples.name: RetryAfterError
examples.title: Error and retry
examples.description: If the onConfirm Promise rejects, the dialog stays open and shows the error; the second attempt succeeds.
